title: Deal-ready enablement kit: demos, FAQs, talk tracks, and battlecards
creator: Lina Chen
description: Create a compact, prioritized enablement kit for Sales and Customer Success to use during the upcoming console-2025.03 and runtime-1.19 launches. Deliverables: 1) two battlecard variants (quick pitch + technical deep-dive), 2) 3 talk-track sections for AE/CS/SE personas, 3) a 10-minute demo script with step-by-step runbook and a 3-minute teaser demo, 4) a one-page FAQ for procurement/security, and 5) a short objection-handling playbook. Coordinate release notes cadence with Docs and Engineering; ensure any last-minute runtime telemetry changes are reflected in the numbers quoted in the battlecards.
acceptance_criteria: One-page quick battlecard (1 side) and one technical battlecard (2 sides) created and reviewed by Sales Engineering
Demo script validated with a live run and recorded; recording uploaded to Drive
FAQ vetted by Security and Legal and signed off by CS lead
Talk tracks reviewed by Field AEs across two geographies and updated with region-specific pricing/uptime language
Release notes link embedded in all artifacts and final versioned with a release tag
